summary: Team Chat Phase 3a (media + reactions) tested end-to-end. Backend: 1/1 pytest scenario passes against the public URL — POST /team/chat/media rejects text/plain (400), accepts image/png (200 -> {media_id, kind:'image'}), POST /messages with media_id echoes media[0].id, GET /media/{id}?token=<hub-teammate JWT> returns image bytes (200), outsider JWT -> 403, garbage token -> 401, and POST /messages/{id}/react toggles the reaction on/off. FOUND & FIXED a real bug in the react endpoint (see rca_of_issue): react_message's find_one used projection {'_id':0,'reactions':1} which returned an empty dict {} for messages lacking a 'reactions' field (older / broadcast-inserted rows), and 'if not m' treated {} as not-found — every react call for those messages returned 404 in production even though the message existed and belonged to the caller's hub. Verified against applereview's real messages. Frontend: verified in web preview (390x844) — (1) chat-attach opens chat-attach-modal with chat-attach-media (Photo or video) + chat-attach-music. (2) Uploaded an image via API into applereview's hub and confirmed it renders as an INLINE image bubble (data-testid chat-media-image) with the text 'inline pic' underneath, and tapping it opens the full-screen lightbox modal (verified via screenshot — dark backdrop + close pill). (3) Long-press on a message bubble opens chat-actions-modal with the quick-emoji row; tapping chat-emoji-👍 adds a chat-reaction-<id>-👍 chip under the message ('👍 1'); tapping the chip toggles it off. Web file-input driven upload was not exercised (Expo ImagePicker on web can't be driven headlessly); media UPLOAD was validated via API and the inline render + lightbox + reactions were exercised in-browser.
action_items: Consider auditing every db.find_one call in /app/backend/routers/ for the same pattern: `find_one(query, {'_id':0, 'onlyfield': 1})` combined with `if not m:` — projections that omit a mandatory field return {} for legacy docs and get treated as not-found. Safer pattern is `if m is None:` and/or always include `'id': 1` in the projection.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the 404 on POST /api/team/chat/messages/{id}/react: react_message called `db.team_messages.find_one({...}, {'_id':0, 'reactions':1})`. For messages inserted without a `reactions` field (e.g., older Phase 1/2 rows, broadcast-authored rows, or any legacy insert), Motor returns `{}` (an empty dict — the document exists but the projected field is absent). The code then evaluated `if not m:` which is True for `{}`, raising 404. Reproduction: message `E-EOV8ql2ykr` for applereview was found via `find_one({'id':mid})` but returned {} with the projection above, so the endpoint 404'd even though the message existed in the caller's hub. Fix (applied): include `'id':1` in the projection and use `if m is None:`. Regression pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_team_chat_media.py) still passes. UI-driven react (👍 add + toggle off) verified against applereview's own message post-fix.
